capabilities: Uploads Markdown notes to a per-vault Chrome Notepad folder
Syncs changed files automatically every five minutes
Runs a manual vault sync from the command palette or settings
Backs up file IDs and timestamps encrypted on the server
Restores sync mappings after local plugin data is lost
disambiguation: Not a two-way sync; it only uploads Markdown copies to Chrome Notepad and never pulls web edits back into the vault.
extras: Only Markdown files up to 512 KiB are synced; attachments stay in the vault. Sync tokens expire after 90 days and cannot read note contents. The account must have recoverable encryption enabled.
problem: Notes kept in Obsidian have no built-in way to reach a Chrome Notepad account, so a web copy has to be made by hand.

relations.evidence: Send a one-way copy of your Obsidian vault's Markdown notes to a folder in your personal Chrome Notepad account.

summary: One-way uploader that copies a vault's Markdown notes into a folder in a personal Chrome Notepad account.
